name: Build and Fly!
desc:
✈️ Build and Fly – The Ultimate Plane-Building Adventure!

Design, upgrade, and launch your own custom-built plane! Outfly wild hazards, explore endless worlds, and push your creations to the limit! 🌍

🛠️ Build Without Limits – Create your dream aircraft using blocks and parts from the shop!
💥 Dodge the Unexpected – Survive insane obstacles and environmental hazards!
🌎 Explore Dynamic Worlds – Fly through ever-changing, procedurally generated biomes!
🚀 Upgrade Every Flight – Earn cash with each run to improve your speed, durability, and style!
✨ Discover new abilities – Unlock special blocks with unique powers and effects!


How far will your creation go?
